review_type: read-only test and acceptance design review

findings.title: Crash boundaries lack per-event recovery oracles
findings.recommendation: Enumerate each create/write/identity/transition/Sync boundary, distinguishing injected operation errors from forced child-process termination. Specify disk state, restart state/generation, permitted file opens, and response semantics; treat uncertain Sync as uncertain even when bytes are visible.

findings.title: Failure matrix omits exact outcomes for side-effecting stages
findings.recommendation: For lock/read/seek/stat/exclusive-create/identity-check/member-delete/parent-Sync/tombstone failures, map the injection seam to return class, poison scope, catalog possibility, restart behavior, case openability, and zero DB/receipt/Planner/Registry calls.

findings.title: Cross-process schedules and linearization assertions are underspecified
findings.recommendation: Require named IPC barriers at snapshot and lock/revalidation points, force process death while holding locks, avoid sleep-based coordination, and assert one winner/transition, contiguous unique generations, zero loser side effects, no partial reads, and bounded diagnostic waits.

findings.title: Platform execution gates lack a reproducible evidence contract
findings.recommendation: Specify Linux and Windows runner/OS/filesystem metadata, executed assertion list, raw logs and artifact location. Require actual mode/DACL, identity, reparse/link, lock, and directory durability assertions; test Linux openat2 and fallback branches independently; unsupported guarantees fail closed.

findings.title: Future browser E2E responsibility is not traceably linked to supervisor acceptance
findings.recommendation: In the follow-on loopback/SQLite SDD, map supervisor invariants to stable E2E IDs for cross-origin rejection, dual-user isolation, lost-response idempotency, restart, cleanup races, and zero side effects. State that supervisor acceptance cannot unlock classroom pilot by itself.

findings.title: Coverage and observability thresholds need measurable artifacts
findings.recommendation: Define coverage measurement scope/platform-file treatment and archived commands/reports. Validate event schema, cross-process trace propagation, expected event cardinality, and negative scans for paths, secrets, tokens, DSNs, and student content. Keep race/vet/lint/build/platform evidence as separate gates.

strengths: Threat model clearly excludes compromised trusted OS account and requires fail-closed behavior where filesystem guarantees are unavailable.
Linux and Windows real execution are correctly distinguished from cross-compilation.
The design explicitly prevents supervisor unit tests from being mistaken for loopback, Playwright, or real classroom acceptance.
Structured event fields and prohibited sensitive values are specified.
exit_criteria: Add deterministic crash/fault/concurrency matrices with recovery and zero-side-effect oracles.
Define platform-specific CI evidence and unsupported-capability behavior.
Have testing and security reviewers re-review the amended acceptance matrix before implementation.
